Name: Honeyfuggle - The Whimsical Wanderer (NPC)
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=4][b][left]Who's Honeyfuggle?[/left][/b][/size][/color]A mischievous new character has arrived in Pelican Town, and they are here to be everyone's friend! Meet [b][color=#f1c232]Honeyfuggle[/color][/b], a playful "sightseer" who recently settled into a tent in Cindersap forest. They're friendly, easy to talk to, and oh-so-silly. But what's with that mask? And that name? Something about them seems so out of place, but where are they from? What are they [i]really[/i] doing here? Perhaps there is a way for you to find out...

[list]
[*][b]Name:[/b] Honeyfuggle
[*][b]Gender:[/b] Genderqueer (any/all pronouns)
[*][b]Age:[/b] 20-something. Probably.
[*][b]Birthday: [/b]Winter 2
[*][b]Orientation:[/b] Pan
[*][b]Status:[/b] Non-Romanceable
[*][b]Origin: [/b]Unknown
[*][b]Occupation:[/b] Unknown
[/list]Please respect my decision on Honeyfuggle being non-romanceable; I currently have no intention of changing it, as I feel a romance would not suit her story (particularly the prospect of marriage).

[size=4][b][left][color=#f1c232]What does this mod add?[/color][/left][/b][/size][list]
[left][*][u]One NPC[/u] who can be unlocked by visiting the railroad. They have over [u]200 lines[/u] of dialogue and a [u]randomized schedule[/u].
[*]An overarching story told over the course of [u]seven events[/u] (including an epilogue). The finale, the 10 heart event, brings about a big change in Honeyfuggle's day-to-day activities. This story has some elements of magical/supernatural events so if you like your game being super grounded in reality, this mod may not be for you!
[*]A [u]small custom map[/u] that Honeyfuggle calls home. After seeing their intro event, it can be found in the Cindersap forest near the Hat Mouse's shop.
[*][u]Seasonal outfits [/u](plus some for festivals).
[*]A custom [u]music track[/u] for the 10 heart event.
[*]Several [u]config options[/u].
[/left][/list]For detailed information about Honeyfuggle's gift tastes, events, schedules, etc., please see the Articles tab!

[color=#f1c232][size=4][b]Installation/Use[/b][/size][/color]
1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/url] if you haven't already. Both of these mods are required by Honeyfuggle to work properly.
2. Download and install this mod.
3. Edit the config to your liking, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ recommended. Options include:[list]
[*]Seasonal Outfits: [b][u]full[/u][/b] gives Honeyfuggle a full range of outfits for all seasons and some festivals. [b][u]vanilla[/u][/b] limits their wardrobe to one default outfit and one winter outfit, to match vanilla NPCs.
[*]Immersive Mode: [u][b]true[/b][/u] makes finishing the Magic Ink quest a requirement for viewing the 10 heart event, [b][u]false[/u][/b] lets you see it at any time (assuming the other preconditions are true). true is recommended unless you're using one of those mods that make the Community Center a lot more time-consuming to complete.
[*]Perfection Requirement: [b][u]true[/u][/b] makes max friendship with Honeyfuggle a requirement for perfection, [b][u]false[/u][/b] does not.
[/list]4. Play the game! To [color=#f1c232][b]unlock Honeyfuggle[/b][/color], go to the railroad any time between 7am and 5pm and watch the event. If you installed the mod mid-save, you might experience some funkiness with her schedule on the first day. This is normal and will go away the next day.

FOR UNINSTALLING: Remove or delete Honeyfuggle from your Mods folder. You will receive a message in your SMAPI console about this on the first day after uninstalling but it will go away after sleeping.

[size=4][b][color=#f1c232][left]Compatibility and Mod Integration[/left][/color][/b][/size]This mod is designed for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b]! Please do not attempt to use with older versions of the game.

Compatibility with multiplayer is untested. Please make sure that everyone in your game has Honeyfuggle downloaded or else you [b]will[/b] run into issues.

[size=3][b][u]This mod is compatible with all major expansions, including [color=#f1c232]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color].[/u][/b][/size]

Below is a list of mods that Honeyfuggle has explicit compatibility/integration with. Other mods not listed here will most likely work, but if you run into issues, feel free to make a post about it in the comment section or, [b]if it's breaking things in a major way[/b], open a bug report.

[b]Gift Tastes - Honeyfuggle will have unique tastes and even unique dialogue lines for certain items added by these mods[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url]﻿
[*]Cornucopia ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]More Flowers[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]More Crops[/url]﻿)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29720]Baubles[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿
[/list][b]Dialogue - lore will be kept consistent[/b][left][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url]﻿
[*]Less Corrupt Lewis ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14269]regular[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18302]Lenny[/url]﻿ version)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14272]Solstice Winter Star[/url]﻿
[/list][b]Recolors - map patches will be automatically recolored to fit the color palette[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor [/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[*]Any mod that changes dirt colors
[/list][b]Other[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14377]Lasting Conversation Topics[/url]﻿ - Honeyfuggle's conversation topics will not expire so you won't miss what other villagers have to say about them after watching certain events.
[*][url=https://ko-fi.com/s/f5b179e3f1]Overgrown Valley[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url]﻿, and other mods that change the placement of trees/grass in the Forest - There might be a tree clipping inside the tent on the first day but this will go away after sleeping.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ - Honeyfuggle will attend both festivals added by this mod, the Ridgeside Gathering and Ember of Resolutions.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿ - Honeyfuggle has a chance to visit Saturday hangouts in Sunberry after seeing his 10 heart event. He will also stand at the non-binary stall that Sunberry adds to the Ridgeside Gathering.
[/list][/left][size=4][left][color=#f1c232][b]Future Plans[/b][/color][/left][/size][list]
[*]Optional events unrelated to the main storyline
[*]A side quest with new items
[*]More random lighthearted stuff to make Honeyfuggle an even more fun inclusion in your game!
[/list][size=4][b][left][color=#f1c232]Permissions[/color][/left][/b][/size]I do not consent to any Honeyfuggle-related mods that contain NSFW and/or AI-generated content (which includes translations). I am very happy to have [b]human-made[/b] portrait mods, translations, etc. though, so you are more than welcome to reach out and ask for permission for those! For any of these reasons, I am reachable on the Stardew Valley Discord server ([b]@vinillavin[/b]). I will not interact with accounts that send me a friend request and nothing else. You can also DM me via Nexus, but you probably won't get a reply as quickly as on Discord.

Also, for any translators interested in this mod, please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3494]this article[/url] which contains a few thoughts I have about how language is used in this mod that will hopefully make your job a little bit easier.
